title: Reject renaming as a new mechanism within the synthetic corpus
problem: Reduce repeated deterministic feature computation. The supplied synthetic prior already includes keyed reuse (claim-prior-operation).
failure_case: A missing keyed-reuse capability is not established; the matching operation is already described in Paragraph 1.
hypothesis: The stated feature-memory idea is operationally equivalent to the described memoization; this is a description-level inference, not an executed result (claim-renaming).
contribution: No new research mechanism is justified by this audit. Preserve the rejection and a conditional equivalence diagnostic.
mechanism: No selected candidate. The rejected idea uses the same keyed store-and-reuse mechanism as the synthetic prior.
implementation: No experiment or implementation was executed. If code becomes available, first compare exact operations and encoder-call traces.

experiments.question: Does any supplied implementation add an operation beyond ordinary keyed memoization?
experiments.intervention: If implementation access becomes available, run the proposed implementation and ordinary memoization with a fixed deterministic encoder and identical key semantics.
experiments.negative_control: Use an all-distinct-key sequence, where repeated-key reuse cannot explain an advantage.
baselines: Ordinary keyed memoization with matched capacity and keys
ablations: Disable reuse while keeping the same encoder and key lookup code.
experiments.expected: A pure rename is predicted to produce the same outputs and encoder-call trace as ordinary memoization under matched conditions. No result is measured.
experiments.falsifies: A reproducible additional operation and a trace difference under matched conditions would falsify strict operational equivalence and justify a revised audit.
experiments.stop_condition: Abandon the novelty claim if descriptions and matched traces are equivalent. Do not launch a full evaluation without a distinct operation and a demonstrated problem.
experiments.resource_basis: Code and hardware are not supplied. This conditional diagnostic requires only a small repeated-key and all-distinct-key input set; runtime and resource needs remain unknown.

limitations: Synthetic developer smoke test; not a scientific efficacy evaluation.

next_diagnostics: Stop the current renaming candidate; require an explicit consequential operation before reopening its novelty claim.
